column1: # Minecraft Dungeons II: Unreal Engine 5 (mobile renderer), SDK 20, NVN, Xbox Live services (XSAPI / libHttpClient); update 1.1.1.0.
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py) and brought up on the Mac (docs/agents)

# Unreal: nninitStartup reserves a 62 GB address region and its FMallocBinned3 takes 37 GB of it, so a 64 GB alias region for the bring-up on the Mac. An iPhone needs the allocator cut for the build and a capped region (game_args), as Octopath Traveler 0's profile (docs/reference/memory.md)
# the NPDM declares 20 MB of system resource
# the decoded shader code archives: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders
